name: Safety Net
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach the prevention window. Kate with the Core Set's three interrupts — Decoy, Net Shield, Sacrificial Construct — in an otherwise ordinary Shaper rig. Eternal-legal only. Vantage Point Stage 4a: Sipa for DZMZ Optimizer. Stage 5a: Methuselah for T400 Memory Diamond, Touchstone for Smartware Distributor. Stage 5b: Stowaway for two Creative Commission. Stage 5c: Beta Build for two Diesel. Stage 6b: two Corsair for two Corroder, Lampades for Mayfly, Baker for a Jailbreak. Stage 6c: two Aircheck for two Overclock. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 1: two Coalescence and two Pressure Spike for three Telework Contract and a Creative Commission. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 6b: two Burner for the two Jailbreak, a run on HQ for a run on HQ or R&D. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 6e: two Lobisomem for a Gordian Blade and a Sure Gamble, a decoder for a decoder. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 7e: two Spree for a Touchstone and a Decoy, a run event that moves the deck's Stowaway. The Automata Initiative Stage 2: two Joy Ride for Overclock and Diesel. The Automata Initiative Stage 4: two Living Mural for two Echelon, killer for killer; two Umbrella for two Unity, decoder for decoder, to interface with ice the deck's Stowaway, Spree and Living Mural put trojans on; and two Urban Art Vernissage for two Touchstone, to take a trojan back and install it again. The Automata Initiative Stage 7: two Beatriz Friere Gonzalez for its two Sure Gamble. The Automata Initiative Stage 8a: two AirbladeX (JSRF Ed.) for its two Methuselah, which Spare Parts still carries. Parhelion Stage 5c: two World Tree for its two Conduit, a successful run trading an install for one of its type from the stack. Parhelion Stage 6a: two Flux Capacitor for its two Stowaway, trojan for trojan, and two Orca, a killer beside its Living Mural, for its two Pressure Spike, whose barriers Lobisomem and Corsair still break; both charge a card that already holds a power counter — its Lampades, Coalescence, Lobisomem and AirbladeX. Street Gallery and Spare Parts still carry Stowaway, and Street Gallery Pressure Spike. Parhelion Stage 6c: two Spark of Inspiration for its two Beta Build, an event that installs a program from the stack for another, which can put its Orca on the table for nothing; Spare Parts still carries Beta Build. Midnight Sun Stage 2: two Endurance for its two AirbladeX, a console that breaks any two subroutines for two of its counters; two Hyperbaric for its two Umbrella, decoder for decoder; two Propeller for its two Corsair, fracter for fracter; and two Environmental Testing for its two Urban Art Vernissage, counting the programs and hardware Kate makes cheaper. Street Gallery still carries all four. Midnight Sun Stage 6b: two Deep Dive for its two Burner, an R&D dig after a turn of successful runs on all three centrals; Dead Reckoning and Street Gallery keep Burner. Uprising Stage 1: two Self-modifying Code for its two Lobisomem, a program that trashes itself to fetch another from the stack; Dead Reckoning and Street Gallery keep Lobisomem. Uprising Stage 2: two Euler for its two Coalescence, a decoder that breaks for nothing the turn it is installed; two Mantle for its two Flux Capacitor, a recurring credit for using hardware and programs; Dead Reckoning keeps both. Uprising Stage 3: two Simulchip for its two Hyperbaric, a program trashed for a program back from the heap; two Cordyceps for its two Propeller, a virus that swaps ice on a central success; an Aniccam and a Harmony AR Therapy for its two Orca, a draw for the first event trashed each turn and a heap shuffled back. Dead Reckoning keeps all three cards given up. Downfall Stage 1: two The Artist for two Spree, a connection whose once-per-turn install of a program or piece of hardware is a credit cheaper and Kate's first install too, and two Gauss for two Aircheck, a fracter at strength 4 on the turn it is installed. Downfall Stage 7: two Khusyuk for its two Beatriz Friere Gonzalez, a run on R&D whose access counts the rig's cards of one install cost; Level Pegging, Street Gallery and Dead Reckoning keep Beatriz. Reprints Stage 1 (System Update 2021): two Professional Contacts for the two Gauss, which Level Pegging still carries. Tranche 8 Stage 8a: two Test Run for its two Deep Dive, an event that installs a program from the stack or the heap for free and puts it back on top of the stack as the turn ends; three other decks keep Deep Dive.
